mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-nullable-cell.test.ts:nullable table access returns nine usable cells and null at each integer boundary without mutation
outcomes: Nine nullable cell handles read expected text/properties; eight integer boundaries return null while strict cell access throws; archive unchanged.
gaps: In-memory matrix only; not path persistence or every table topology.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-nullable-cell.test.ts:nullable access refuses invalid numeric coordinates without coercion even if the other axis is outside
outcomes: Noninteger nonfinite unsafe and nonnumeric coordinates refuse without coercion even when the other axis is outside; negative zero resolves first cell.
gaps: Invalid-input policy exceeds shared integer-boundary predicate; no general proxy or hostile runtime claim.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-nullable-cell.test.ts:nullable cells edit through the existing checked path and saved tables reopen with all original coordinates
outcomes: Nullable cell edits use checked mutation; held cell goes stale; path reopen preserves all nine coordinates, edited text and unrelated payloads.
gaps: One edit to one rectangular table; independent Office rendering and merge editing untested.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-nullable-cell.test.ts:stale structural handles refuse both in-range and out-of-range nullable lookup
outcomes: Structurally stale tables reject in-range and out-of-range nullable reads with exact archive custody.
gaps: One insertion case; no arbitrary concurrent mutation evidence.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-nullable-cell.test.ts:externally changed table bytes cannot masquerade as a missing cell
outcomes: Externally changed document XML refuses nullable access both in-range and outside without changing archive.
gaps: One external text replacement; not every external graph or package mutation.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-nullable-cell.test.ts:nullable access does not hide merged cells unsupported grids or unsafe cell text
outcomes: Merged target and unsupported grid refuse; out-of-range merged-table coordinate returns null; unsafe nested cell text still refuses; archives unchanged.
gaps: Only three topology variants; no merged-table support or general schema-validation claim.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-nullable-cell.test.ts:shared nullable profile executes one case and detects missing in-range cells or fabricated boundary cells
outcomes: One shared nullable-cell scenario executes; missing fifth cell and fabricated boundary cell controls fail without undefined bindings.
gaps: Scenario checks nine object-presence results and four null boundaries only; save/reopen remains separate native evidence.
